name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. 'chapter_10' encodes the meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are domain IDs, not Ghidra address residue). Dispatched from data_fd2_chapter_init_handler_table at index 9 (entry @0x51d95 = table base 0x51d71 + 0x24), which is chapter 10 (0-indexed table, chapter N at index N-1). Name accurately reflects purpose.
purpose: Chapter 10 init handler: re-inits battle state, pans the camera, seeds two NPC units asleep, plays one dialog page, and pans the camera to char 0.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter(); pans via fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0xA,0); sets runtime_char[0x32].status_sleep_flag=100 (索菲亞) and runtime_char[0x33].status_sleep_flag=100 (卡納恩三世) so both NPCs start the battle asleep (field at struct offset +0x26); plays dialog page 0 via fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text,0,...); then fd2_pan_cursor_to_char(0). No cutscene, no portrait load, no char init -- party carries over from chapter 9. Leading __CHK(0x28) is the Watcom frame-size probe, not source body. In the binary the page-0 dialog + final pan are a tail-JMP into the shared chain (0x3344D -> 0x33206 -> 0x33140); src is the functionally-equivalent straight-line reconstruction.

returns.semantics: No return value; dispatched handler invoked for side effects (battle/NPC/camera/dialog setup).
